transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… it’s my eating. After my shifts at the register, I keep stopping for takeout and buying way too much, like burgers, fries, chicken, desserts… enough for a whole family. Then I sit there and eat almost all of it myself before I go home.
Do you feel upset or have problems in your life because of these eating episodes?

Yeah… I mean, I still make it to work and do my shifts. But it’s causing problems. I’m spending money we really don’t have on food, and I keep hiding it from my wife. Things at home feel… tense. Like I’m not being honest.
When you're eating all that food, do you feel like you can't stop or control how much you're eating?
Yeah… I do. It’s like once I take the first bite, something kind of shuts off. I’ll be thinking, “Demetrius, stop, you don’t need more,” but… I just keep reaching for the next thing anyway.
Do you feel distressed or upset specifically about not being able to stop eating once you start, even before considering the consequences like spending money or hiding it from your wife?

Yeah… I do. It’s embarrassing, but that part gets to me. Once I take that first bite, it’s like something clicks off, and even when I’m telling myself to stop, my hands just keep going to the next thing.
When you're eating during these episodes, do you find yourself eating much more rapidly than normal, like eating quickly without really thinking about it?
I don’t know… I haven’t really paid attention to how fast I’m eating. It just kind of happens.
Do you find yourself eating until you feel uncomfortably full during these episodes?
Yeah… a lot of nights I do. I’ll keep going until my stomach feels tight, like it actually hurts. Sometimes I have to lean the seat back or just lie still and wait for it to pass.
Do you find yourself eating even when you’re not really hungry during these episodes?
Yeah… most of the time I’m not really hungry. Even if I already had dinner with my wife, I’ll still end up looking for something. It’s like… I don’t know, like I’m trying to quiet my head down.
After these eating episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit, use laxatives, or exercise excessively to try to control your weight or get rid of the food?
I… I don’t really know. I mean, I don’t think so. I haven’t really done anything like that on purpose, not that I can think of.

F50.8 (Other Specified Eating or Feeding Disorder) remains as a possible alternative, but F50.2 remains the most fitting diagnosis given current information.
